title: Helm Schema config file
description: JSON Schema for the "helm schema" plugin, allowing you to set configs using a config file instead of using command-line flags. The default file name used by "helm schema" is ".schema.yaml".

bundle.description: Bundle referenced ($ref) subschemas into a single file inside $defs. Flag: --bundle

bundleCacheMin.description: Minimum cache duration for downloaded schemas, e.g. "24h" or "30m". Raises short server Cache-Control max-age values so schemas stay cached longer. An empty string follows the server's caching headers. Flag: --bundle-cache-min

bundleRoot.description: Root directory to allow local referenced files to be loaded from. Defaults to the current working directory. Flag: --bundle-root

bundleWithoutID.description: Bundle without using $id to reference bundled schemas, which improves compatibility with e.g the VS Code JSON extension. Flag: --bundle-without-id

k8sSchemaURL.description: URL template used in "$ref: $k8s/..." alias. Uses Go text templating, where "{{ .K8sSchemaVersion }}" maps to the k8sSchemaVersion config. Flag: --k8s-schema-url

k8sSchemaVersion.description: Version used in the "k8sSchemaURL" template for "$ref: $k8s/..." alias. This setting has no default value and must be set in order to use the "$k8s" alias. Flag: --k8s-schema-version

noAdditionalProperties.description: Default additionalProperties to false for all objects in the schema. Objects that also get properties from an in-place applicator ("$ref", "allOf", "anyOf", "oneOf", "if"/"then"/"else", "dependentSchemas") get "unevaluatedProperties" instead on draft 2019-09 and later, because "additionalProperties" cannot see those properties and would reject them. Flag: --no-additional-properties

noDefaultGlobal.description: Disable automatic injection of 'global' property when schema root does not allow it. Flag: --no-default-global

schemaRoot.description: Set of configs for configuring properties on the output root schema. Flag: --schema-root.*

additionalProperties.description: JSON Schema "additionalProperties" on the output schema root. This has precedence over the "noAdditionalProperties" config. Flag: --schema-root.additionalProperties

description.description: JSON Schema "description" on the output schema root. Flag: --schema-root.description

id.description: JSON Schema "$id" on the output schema root. Flag: --schema-root.id

ref.description: JSON Schema "$ref" on the output schema root. When using local file references (e.g "./foobar.json") the path is relative to your .schema.yaml config file. Flag: --schema-root.ref

title.description: JSON Schema "title" on the output schema root. Flag: --schema-root.title

useHelmDocs.description: Read descriptions from https://github.com/norwoodj/helm-docs comments. Flag: --use-helm-docs

values.description: One or more YAML files as inputs. Flag: --values, -f
